name: sessionStorage
plain: A per tab store of up to about 5 MB that is cleared when the tab closes.
meaning: Used for checkout steps and form state, and for trackers that carry a 'session ID' inside one tab. Different tabs of one site do not share it, so it cannot follow the person across tabs. Copied into a tab opened by window.open.

access.persistence: Until the tab or window closes. Browsers may restore it after crash or tab restore
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can keep up to about 5 MB of notes for this tab until you close it
limits.user_action: Nothing. It happens as you move through steps or forms in the tab.
can: Remember form steps and choices while the tab is open
Keep them when you reload the page
Keep a separate set for each tab
cannot: Share them with your other tabs
Keep them after you close the tab

story.what_it_is: A store of up to about 5 MB for one tab that is cleared when you close the tab.

marketing.name: Window.sessionStorage
marketing.pitch: Documents how a page can keep data for the life of one tab.

story.for_you: You never see it. It is why a form can hold what you typed while you click through the steps, and why a new tab starts fresh.
story.for_makers: Makers use it for short lived state like multi step forms and temporary tokens. It is safer than long term storage, because it disappears with the tab. It is also used for session IDs in analytics.

use_cases.example: A checkout keeps your shipping choices while you move through the steps.
A bank keeps a short lived token in the tab and loses it when you close it.
A browser game keeps the current level in a tab but does not save it forever.
A booking site keeps your search and seat choices while you compare flights.
A site analytics script uses it to mark one visit as one session.
An online test keeps your answers in the tab until you submit.

technical_bounds: About 5 MiB per origin per tab
Separate per tab even for the same origin
Cloned (not shared) when a tab is duplicated

abuse: Per tab session IDs for analytics

history.change: Third party sessionStorage partitioned by top level site
